answer: Farming becomes a shale bet on surviving 68 epochs of grading, and every gale settlement recomputes the mesa schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 68 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
